Screen every US-listed stock with conditions you set yourself

A web page, nothing to install: 6,616 US-listed stocks from Nasdaq's public screener feed (prices as of 2026-10-07), filtered in your browser. Add conditions, combine them with AND, export the matches. Built 2026-10-07 21:14 GMT.

Presets: Margin over 10%, revenue up 15%+, price 20%+ below 3-year high Large caps 30%+ below their 3-year high Up 50%+ in 12 months, above $1B Technology, above $10B, positive day

What is real here, and what the full build adds

  • Universe: all 6,616 US-listed stocks (Nasdaq, NYSE, AMEX) with price, day change, market cap, volume, sector, industry and IPO year, from Nasdaq's public screener feed. Free, no key.
  • Price history metrics (1, 3, 6, 12-month performance; distance from the 3-year and 52-week highs and the 52-week low): computed from 3 years of daily closes on Yahoo Finance's free feed for the 499 largest companies by market cap. A stock without history fails any history condition.
  • Fundamental metrics (revenue growth, margins, free cash flow, earnings growth, P/E, ROE): Yahoo Finance's free summary for the 100 largest. The full build refreshes these nightly for every stock you choose, with quarter, year and TTM changes computed from the statements themselves.
  • How the real screener keeps this free: a scheduled job (GitHub Actions, free) refreshes the data file every night; the page or app reads the file, so screening stays instant and there is no monthly fee. Limits of the free feed: it is unofficial, rate-limited (a full refresh of thousands of tickers runs in batches over the night) and holds about 4 to 5 years of statements.

Data: Nasdaq screener feed and Yahoo Finance, free tiers, fetched on 2026-10-07 21:14 GMT. For demonstration only, not investment advice.
